problem: 1. robots.txt blocking — crawler disallowed from path
2. IP blocking / rate limiting — too many requests trigger a ban
3. CAPTCHA challenges — human-verification blocks
4. Login/authentication walls — content hidden behind session
5. Geo-blocking — content restricted by region
6. WAF/bot detection (Cloudflare, Akamai, etc.) blocking automated traffic
7. JavaScript-rendered content — empty HTML without executing JS
8. Dynamic/lazy-loaded content — infinite scroll, AJAX-loaded sections
9. Broken or malformed HTML — parsing errors
10. Redirect loops/chains — URL bounces endlessly
11. 404 / dead links
12. 500 / server errors
13. Timeouts — slow server response
14. SSL/TLS certificate errors
15. DNS resolution failures
16. Duplicate content — same content, multiple URLs
17. Encoding issues — garbled/non-UTF-8 text
18. Non-HTML files — PDFs, images, videos needing special handling
19. Pagination confusion — crawler can't find/follow "next page"
20. Session ID / tracking parameter URLs — infinite URL variations of same page
21. Crawler traps — infinite URL generation (calendars, filters)
23. Canonical tag mismatches — confusion about preferred URL version
24. URL normalization issues — www vs non-www, http vs https, trailing slash, case sensitivity
27. Server overload from aggressive crawling (unintentional DoS)
28. Content changes between crawl and use (staleness)
29. A/B tested content — different users see different content
30. Inconsistent structure across pages — hard to generalize parsing logic
